[[File:Blue wizard robe detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''blue wizard robe''' is the most basic piece of chest armour for low level [[Magic]] users. It can be turned into a [[black robe]] by using [[black dye]] on it; similarly, it can be created by using [[blue dye]] on a black robe.

The blue robe is often worn with the [[blue wizard hat]] and [[blue skirt]] for aesthetics.

One of only three [[Body slot table (F2P)|free-to-play bodies]] with a magic attack bonus, the Blue wizard robe, [[Black robe]], and their [[Ornamental armour|ornamental variants]] get +1 [[Magic]] attack and -3 [[Prayer]] bonus compared to the [[Zamorak monk top]].
